description: Retrieve non-sensitive metadata on prior tool invocations for an entity (count, timestamps, last hash). Never returns ciphertext. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 15. Cost $0.01 per call.

entity_id.description: Entity whose prior tool invocations should be summarised.

owner_wallet.description: 0x-prefixed owner wallet. Only that owner's rows are counted.

tool_name.description: Tool name to look up, e.g. 'verify_biodiversity' or 'request_mrv_report'.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the tool-context message.

name: memory.tool_context

outputSchema.description: Non-sensitive metadata about prior tool invocations. Never ciphertext.

hash_chain_intact.description: Reserved; always true until anchors land.

last_content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the last write's plaintext.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Tool Context
